results.title: Confirmed domain shows the logo preview in the brand card within moments
results.notes: PROD re-check in the wizard of analysis A: custom brand "Licter" (CSV "Lictorix Geo"), URL "https://www.licter.com/en/page?x=1" (CSV W1 "licter.com"). Avatar "L" 32x32 (bg-red-500) while empty and while typing. On blur (MutationObserver): grey pulsing span 32x32 (h-8 w-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-slate-200, no text) at ~+1.05 s, then IMG 32x32 Brandfetch URL at +1.18 s, then IMG 32x32 www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com at +1.84 s. One lookup GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com 200 -> logoUrl https://cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png?c=1idqBOqddsIGy5EF11F. In the headless browser Brandfetch answers 302 -> docs.brandfetch.com (x-bf-error: automated_traffic), so the card shows the Google favicon fallback (licter mark, black). curl with a desktop Chrome UA: 200 image/png 64x64 (purple "lic ter" logo, saved as licter_brandfetch_logo_chromeUA.png). Domain "licter.com" shown under "Licter". Visual check of the Brandfetch logo in a real browser: CONFIRMED by the user on 29/10/2026 (purple Licter logo displayed) -> PASS.

results.notes: PROD, A1 = analysis A 62be61d8-444b-4d7f-9366-092e75211be5 ("Licter", created after the release, COMPLETED). GET /reports: entityDomain licter.com, entityDomainConfirmed true, entityLogoUrl = L1 = https://cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png?c=1idqBOqddsIGy5EF11F; headless request -> 302 (x-bf-error automated_traffic) -> app falls back to www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (loaded). Visual comparison with L1 (Brandfetch) to be checked by the user in a real browser.
